apps.title: Applications
apps.lead: Typical Nordic and Baltic use cases. We help choose pulsed MOPA vs CW.

items.d: Injection and tire molds: carbon, release agent and oxide without changing dimensions. Pulsed MOPA first choice.
Controlled heat on fittings, monuments and thin historic surfaces. Low HAZ matters more than area rate.
Handheld CW welding with wire feed for carbon and stainless. Faster joints, less distortion on thin plate.
Mobile carts for weld prep and coating removal. Heavy structural area rates may need CW, not a 300 W pulse unit.
Chemical-free cleaning of process equipment when the surface must stay intact.
Rust, paint and oxide before weld or coat. Sale and rental for seasonal peaks.

safety.title: Safety & CE
safety.lead: These are Class 4 laser systems. We do not treat safety as a brochure footnote.
body: AMTech supplies industrial machines intended for trained operators in controlled workspaces.
We prefer units with CE documentation (Declaration of Conformity and supporting technical file). Exact package is confirmed per serial.
EN 60825 Class 4: beam can injure eyes and skin and is a fire risk. Appropriate eyewear, interlocks, controlled area and fume extraction are required.
This page is awareness, not legal advice. The buyer remains responsible for workplace laser safety, national rules and operator competence.
Training and a safety briefing are part of our commissioning offer.

clean-300.name: AMTech Clean 300
clean-300.short: Pulsed handheld laser cleaner (~300 W) for mobile and light industrial jobs.
clean-300.card: Precision rust, paint and oxide removal with controlled heat. Preferred for molds, thin aluminium, food-grade stainless, restoration and light maintenance.

Pulse energy options confirmed per unit
Sale and rental in Finland and the Nordics

clean-500.name: AMTech Clean 500
clean-500.short: Flagship pulsed handheld cleaner (~500 W) for higher throughput.
clean-500.card: More capacity on steel, rail and thicker coatings while keeping pulsed low-HAZ behaviour. Use when 300 W is the bottleneck but precision still matters.

multi-1500.name: AMTech Multi 1500
